blurb: As a premier Ventura County Wedding Venue, Maravilla Gardens offers a stunning backdrop for your special day. The knowledge and talent of horticulture and landscaping meets inspired wedding venue design at Maravilla Gardens, capable of accommodating up to 275 guests. The owners are a team composed of a landscape contractor, a nursery woman, and an artist. Building began in 2003 and continues today.
